title: Photo Booth Hire Dunstable | Boothdrop Entertainment
metaDescription: Photo booth hire in Dunstable, Houghton Regis and the villages around the Downs. Attendant, props and prints included, from £239. Get a free quote today.
intro: Dunstable sits in Bedfordshire at the foot of the Chilterns, with the Downs to the south and Luton on its eastern edge. We bring a professional attendant, a choice of booths and everything needed for the night, with packages from £239 and delivery and setup included.

sections.heading: Dunstable, Houghton Regis and the villages we reach
paragraphs: Dunstable is a Bedfordshire town, and we cover it together with neighbouring Houghton Regis and the Woodside side of town. Out in the countryside we regularly go to Totternhoe, Kensworth, Toddington and Eaton Bray, and Leighton Buzzard lies a short drive to the west. Luton is immediately to the east, which matters if your guest list is large enough to need one of its banqueting suites. Across the county border in Hertfordshire, Markyate and Harpenden are also within easy reach.

The A5, the A505 and the A5 to M1 link road tie these places together, with junctions 9 to 11A of the M1 close by, so most journeys are short. Delivery, setup and pack-down cost nothing extra. If a travel contribution ever applied to a far-flung venue, it would be shown on your quote up front, before you commit to anything.

sections.heading: The sort of rooms people hire here
paragraphs: Hosts in this part of Bedfordshire tend to choose from a handful of familiar venue types. Village halls and community centres are the everyday favourites for christenings, anniversaries and birthdays. Golf clubs and hotels on the edge of the Downs take the weddings and milestone parties that want a view. School halls fill up in early summer for proms and leavers' events, and business parks host conferences, awards evenings and staff Christmas parties.

Each of these has different quirks, from low ceilings in older village halls to stage lighting in school halls. When you send us the venue type and rough guest count we suggest a booth that fits the space rather than squeezing in the biggest one.

sections.heading: Roads, loading and setup on the day
paragraphs: Most venues around Dunstable have a car park beside the hall, so the attendant can unload close to the door and then move the vehicle. Where a hall sits on a narrow village lane, we ask you to mention it when booking and we agree a drop-off point in advance. If the function room is upstairs, tell us whether there is a lift. A slim pod can be carried up a staircase by two people, while the larger booths are happier on the ground floor.

Every booth runs from one standard plug socket, apart from the Inflatable Booth, which needs two. The attendant arrives to build 45 to 60 minutes before your hire window starts, and that setup time is not charged as hire time, so your guests get every minute they booked.

sections.heading: Which booth works for a Dunstable event
paragraphs: For halls and community centres, the LCD SlimPod is the practical choice: it needs only 1.5m by 2m of floor, handles up to six guests per shot and is our most popular and most affordable booth. Hotels and golf clubs on the Downs edge give the Magic Mirror the ceiling height and floor space it likes, and its on-screen animations keep a wedding reception entertained between speeches and the first dance.

If you are planning a large Asian wedding in a Luton suite, the curtained Party Booth gives guests privacy. For milestone birthdays and company parties, the 360 Booth adds slow-motion video with music; we confirm the space it needs with your venue when we quote.

sections.heading: Planning advice for common occasions
paragraphs: For weddings, book the booth for the evening reception rather than the drinks hour, when guests are relaxed and the dance floor is filling. A long hire window beats a short one for big guest lists, because unlimited sessions mean nobody has to queue. For Asian weddings and multi-day celebrations, ask for a quote that covers every date and we can change the print template for each event.

Proms and birthdays work best with a booth near the entrance, where photos are taken as people arrive. Corporate hosts should send us a logo early so the overlay is ready, and Christmas party organisers should enquire well ahead, as December Fridays and Saturdays fill early. Each booking includes props, digital copies, social sharing and a guest book on print booths.

sections.heading: What a Dunstable booking includes
paragraphs: Packages start from £239. Each one includes a professional attendant, unlimited sessions for the whole hire, props, a custom print or overlay template with your text and logo, LED lighting, digital copies with email and social sharing, and public liability insurance. An £80 deposit secures your date and the balance is due one month before the event. Green screen is available on request, and we are rated 5 stars on Trustpilot.

faqs.q: Where do you park and unload at a Dunstable venue?
faqs.a: Most halls, clubs and hotels around Dunstable have their own car park, so we unload at the nearest door and then park. If your venue sits on a narrow lane or has restricted access, tell us when you book and we will agree a drop-off point in advance.

faqs.q: Can you set up in an upstairs room or a hall with steps?
faqs.a: Yes, with notice. Two of the team can carry a slim pod up a staircase, and ramps or lifts make it easier still. The Magic Mirror, Party Booth and Inflatable Booth prefer level access, so tell us about stairs when you book and we will recommend a suitable option.

faqs.q: Do you charge extra to travel to Dunstable or Houghton Regis?
faqs.a: No. Delivery, setup and pack-down are included in every package. If any travel contribution ever applied to a far-flung venue, it would be shown on your quote up front, before you pay a deposit, and never added afterwards.

faqs.q: Can you cover a wedding in Luton as well as one in Dunstable?
faqs.a: Yes. Luton is immediately next door, so we cover its banqueting suites as readily as venues in Dunstable and the villages. Ask for a quote covering every date, such as mehndi and reception, and we will price them together.

faqs.q: Will the booth fit in a small village hall?
faqs.a: Usually, yes. The LCD SlimPod needs just 1.5m by 2m of floor space and a single standard socket. Send us the hall size or a few phone photos and we will confirm which booths fit comfortably before you pay a deposit.
